chunks: Abān ibn Taghlib narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, peace be upon them:
He was asked about a man who made a bequest of something from his wealth, so he said: "The thing, in the Book of ʿAlī, peace be upon him, is one out of six."

key_terms.بِشَيْءٍ: an unspecified portion mentioned in a bequest
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: the recorded legal reference attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.وَاحِدٌ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ: one-sixth as the defined legal amount

ai.seo_question: When someone bequeaths "something" from his wealth, how much does that mean in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bequest expressed as "something" from a person's wealth. Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام explains that, according to the Book of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, this unspecified amount is understood as one-sixth of the estate.
